Phoenix, Arizona · fix

Bike shops in Phoenix: repairs, parts, rentals

Bike shops in Phoenix that do repairs. If something breaks in transit or the night before, start here. Call ahead on event weekends. Mechanics get slammed.

Bike shops in Phoenix: repairs, parts, rentals, listed

  1. Bike Emporium

    8443 E. McDonald Dr., Scottsdale, AZ 85250 · (480) 991-5430

    repairrentalrental-roadrental-gravelrental-mtb

    South Scottsdale, at the southeast corner of Granite Reef and McDonald, in the plaza behind Walgreens; about 11 miles northeast of downtown Phoenix. The one Valley shop that publishes its rental fleet and prices: a 2023 carbon Cannondale SuperSix EVO with Shimano 105 and disc brakes, sizes 48 to 61 cm, $90 per 24 hours; a 2024 Marin Kentfield 1 aluminum gravel bike, 49 to 59 cm, $60; a 2023 Cannondale Habit full-suspension mountain bike, S to XL, $85 (Oct 2026). Helmet, lock and bottle cage with every rental; pedals and a repair kit with the road and mountain bikes (the page doesn't say so for the gravel bike). A $50 non-refundable deposit holds a road, gravel or mountain bike. No e-bikes. Builds bikes bought elsewhere and boxes bikes for shipping, prices not published; it does not say it takes in a carrier delivery. Monday to Friday 9 to 5, Saturday 9 to 3, closed Sunday.

  2. McDowell Mountain Cycles

    11879 N. Saguaro Blvd., Fountain Hills, AZ · (480) 272-8741

    repairsuspensionrentalrental-roadrental-gravelrental-mtbrental-ebikeshop-rides

    Fountain Hills, about 23 miles northeast of downtown Phoenix; the shop for the northeast loops and McDowell Mountain Regional Park, on Saguaro Blvd where the Rio Verde – Fountain Hills loop passes. Rents road, gravel, mountain and e-bikes with helmet and pedals (a few clipless sets, so say so when you book) and a flat kit. ID at pickup, $25 to cancel, a car rack for $40 a booking, and delivery in Fountain Hills and to McDowell Mountain Regional Park. No rental prices on the site (Oct 2026); call. Service runs Alloy, Carbon and Titanium tune packages, the last with fork and shock service. The shop's road ride (Some Saturdays, 6:30 am) and Sunday Funday gravel (Some Sundays, 6:30 am) leave from the door. Monday to Friday 8 to 5, Saturday 8 to 4, closed Sunday.

  3. The Velo

    2317 N 7th St, Phoenix, AZ 85006 · (602) 759-8169

    repairfittingshop-rides

    Phoenix, in the Coronado neighborhood, about 2 miles north of downtown; the closest of these shops to a downtown or Roosevelt Row stay. Walk-ins welcome; a flat fix is $10, tune-ups $90, $150 and $250 (Oct 2026). Fits for road, gravel, mountain, tri and cleats, $90 to $180, 30 to 120 minutes; call or text to book. Custom builds. Runs a weekly shop ride from the door; the day and time are on its Ride With Us page. Open every day: Monday to Friday 10 to 6, Saturday 10 to 4, Sunday 10 to 2.

  4. Bike Barn

    4112 N 36th St, Phoenix, AZ 85018 · (602) 956-3870

    repairfittingrentalrental-roadrental-mtb

    East Phoenix, on 36th Street, about 5 miles northeast of downtown. "If we can fix it on the spot, we will"; pick-up and delivery within 10 miles. Rents road, mountain and city bikes through an online booking page; prices and sizes are not on the shop's own pages (Oct 2026). Specialized Body Geometry fits by appointment: basic $90, comprehensive 2D $150 (Oct 2026). Closed Monday; Tuesday to Saturday 9 to 5, Sunday 11 to 4.

  5. Regroup Coffee + Bicycles

    1205 N Scottsdale Rd, Tempe, AZ 85288 · (480) 648-8309

    repairfittingshop-ridescoffee

    Tempe, on Scottsdale Road, about 8 miles east of downtown Phoenix. A café and a bike shop in one room, and the start of the Regroup coffee ride (Saturdays, 6:30 am). Service is booked, not walk-in: Bronze $125, Silver $250, Gold $400 (Oct 2026); the place to meet the Tempe riders, not the place for an emergency fix. Fits with motion capture, saddle pressure mapping and AiRO; price not published. Bike shop: Monday by appointment, Tuesday to Friday 10 to 6, Saturday 10 to 4, closed Sunday (the shop's own service page shows shorter Friday and Saturday hours; call). The café opens at 6:30 every day but Monday.

  6. Global Bikes & E-Bikes Chandler North

    2915 West Ray Road #10, Chandler, AZ 85224 · (480) 899-3625

    repairsuspensionshop-rides

    East Valley, at the southeast corner of Ray Road and the 101 next to Whole Foods, about 14 miles southeast of downtown Phoenix. One of five Global Bikes stores (Ahwatukee, Chandler North and South, Gilbert, Mesa); repairs regular bikes and e-bikes, from flats to fork and shock rebuilds and wheel building. The chain runs free rides and clinics every week; the Chandler North ride (Saturdays, 6:00 am) starts here. Open every day: Monday to Friday 10 to 7, Saturday 10 to 6, Sunday 11 to 4.
